name: ghost_logs
description: Fetch logs from a database. Returns log entries in chronological order (oldest first). By default, returns the last 500 log entries.

tail.description: Number of log lines to fetch

until.description: Fetch logs before this timestamp (RFC3339 format, e.g., 2024-01-15T10:00:00Z). If not provided, fetches up to the current time.
